name: RMIT Student Welfare financial advice
summary: Appointments with a Student Welfare Advisor for help with budgeting, hardship grants, emergency vouchers, fines and government support.
how: Book online, choosing Student Welfare, or call Student Connect on +61 3 9925 5000.
catches: Funded by SSAF. The page doesn't say whether it's free.
Appointments are at City campus or by phone.

evidence.quote: A Student Welfare Advisor will help you understand what support options are available to you.
